bio.text: Diane Harris, a Joliet Junior College trustee, won the Republican primary for Illinois secretary of state on March 17, 2026.
She ran for mayor of Joliet in 2011 after retiring from ComEd, was elected to the Joliet Junior College board in 2023, and for several years owned a downtown Joliet clothing boutique.

sources.title: Joliet Junior College trustee now GOP candidate for Illinois secretary of state
